top_current_affairs.title: Implementation of New Criminal Laws (BNS, BNSS, BSA)
top_current_affairs.summary: India transitions to the Bharatiya Nyaya Sanhita, Bharatiya Nagarik Suraksha Sanhita, and Bharatiya Sakshya Adhiniyam, replacing colonial-era laws with a focus on modernizing justice delivery, victim protection, and digital evidence.
top_current_affairs.key_upsc_relevance: Important for questions on judicial reforms, fundamental rights, procedural law efficiency, and the balance between state security and civil liberties.

top_current_affairs.title: India-Middle East-Europe Economic Corridor (IMEEC) Developments
top_current_affairs.summary: Strategic discussions continue on operationalizing the IMEEC to enhance connectivity, boost trade resilience, and provide an alternative global supply chain route amidst Red Sea geopolitical tensions.
top_current_affairs.key_upsc_relevance: Relevant for topics on bilateral/multilateral agreements involving India's strategic interests, Indo-Pacific region, and global supply chain diversification.

top_current_affairs.title: Draft Notification on Western Ghats Ecologically Sensitive Area (ESA)
top_current_affairs.summary: The Ministry of Environment, Forest and Climate Change re-issued a draft notification declaring over 56,000 sq km of the Western Ghats as Ecologically Sensitive Area, balancing biodiversity conservation with local livelihood concerns.
top_current_affairs.key_upsc_relevance: Crucial for questions regarding environmental impact assessments, Kasturirangan/Gadgil committee recommendations, and sustainable development goals.

top_current_affairs.title: RBI's Surplus Transfer to the Central Government
top_current_affairs.summary: The Reserve Bank of India approved a record dividend transfer to the Central Government under the Economic Capital Framework (ECF), aiding fiscal deficit targets and capital expenditure plans.
top_current_affairs.key_upsc_relevance: Key topic for questions on central bank autonomy, Bimal Jalan Committee recommendations, fiscal consolidation, and non-tax revenue sources.

top_current_affairs.title: Adoption of Digital Public Infrastructure (DPI) and AI Governance Frameworks
top_current_affairs.summary: India advances its IndiaAI Mission to democratize AI compute capacity and secure data infrastructure, promoting ethical AI deployment alongside expanding the India Stack to global markets.
top_current_affairs.key_upsc_relevance: Highly significant for questions on emerging technologies, ethical AI frameworks, digital divide, and technology-driven inclusive growth.
